**Unset (null) inputs**
A boolean input is unset (null) when it is connected to an optional workflow parameter that was left empty, or to the output of a step that was skipped by its ``when`` condition. Galaxy cannot evaluate a ``when`` condition that is null, so these tools always return ``true`` or ``false``. The setting for unset inputs says what to do instead:
- **Fail the job** (default): stop with an error that names the unset input. Choose this when an unset input means the workflow is wired wrongly. - **Treat as false** / **Treat as true**: substitute that value and carry on.
Only *connected* inputs can be unset. An input that is not connected uses the value set in the tool form, which is false unless you change it. So if you add an extra input to a combination and leave it unconnected, it counts as false: remove inputs you don't use.
